AWS Data Engineer
YOUR ROLE
•Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines using AWS Redshift, primarily S3 , Cloud 9
•Integrate and manage data workflows in Git repositories, including branching, pull requests, and version control best practices
•Optimize Redshift performance through best practices in schema design, data partitioning, and query optimization
•Monitor pipeline health and data quality; implement alerting and logging as needed.
•Collaborate with Data Analysts, Data Scientists, and Business Stakeholders to understand data needs and deliver reliable datasets.
•Participate in code reviews, testing, and documentation.


YOUR PROFILE
•Bachelor’s degree in computer science
•Extended hands-on experience in AWS Redshift, data pipeline development, and version control systems
•Proficient in - Git, Airflow, DBT
•Should have a good understanding of SDLC and Agile methodologies
•Basic knowledge of Python
•Good understanding of data warehouse architecture and cloud-based data engineering principles.
•Good to have domain knowledge of telecommunication industry
